profile.scope: Ordinary coach screenshot replay. Reward remains separate.

dose.law: B_lo = C_P * A(age) * N / p; B_hi = upperDoseRatio * B_lo
dose.playerStateCalibration: For one observed anchor coach card, invert each affected stat against both observed interval endpoints under the fixed response/rho, minimise endpoint SSE for B_lo, then take the arithmetic mean implied B_lo and solve C_P = mean(B_lo)/(A(age)*N/p).

evaluation.primary: Predicted midpoint versus observed screenshot interval midpoint
evaluation.targetLeakageRule: The target coach event is never used to calibrate C_P.

evidenceBoundary: Observed screenshot ranges are answer keys; frozen assistant predictions are never answer keys.
Calibration is state-local: player, age, tier and stat state must match.
Reward is excluded from ordinary transfer scoring.
Programme/family effects are not silently fitted; results are stratified by family.

mechanism_diagnostics.caveat: A per-stat anchor budget may absorb a wrong marginal curve; it is not proof of stat-specific allocation.

evidenceLimit: Referenced screenshot filenames and chat-transcribed ranges have not been independently checked against image pixels; outcomes are preview ranges, not executed coach gains.
